title: Find Pivot Index
description:
Given an array of integers `nums`, calculate the **pivot index** of this array.

The **pivot index** is the index where the sum of all the numbers **strictly** to the left of the index is equal to the sum of all the numbers **strictly** to the right of the index.

If the index is on the left edge of the array (`i == 0`), the left sum is `0` because there are no elements to the left. This also applies to the right edge of the array (`i == nums.length - 1`), where the right sum is `0`.

Return the **leftmost** pivot index. If no such index exists, return `-1`.
hints: Compute the total sum `S` of the entire array first.
As you scan index `i` from left to right maintaining `leftSum`, the sum strictly to the right of `i` is `S - leftSum - nums[i]`.
Check `leftSum == S - leftSum - nums[i]` before updating `leftSum += nums[i]` so the first match is guaranteed to be the leftmost pivot index.

examples.explanation: The pivot index is 3. Left sum = nums[0] + nums[1] + nums[2] = 1 + 7 + 3 = 11. Right sum = nums[4] + nums[5] = 5 + 6 = 11.
There is no index that satisfies the conditions in the problem statement, so return -1.
The pivot index is 0. Left sum = 0 (no elements to the left of index 0). Right sum = nums[1] + nums[2] = 1 + (-1) = 0.
